notes.claim: A matrix represents the move that takes the basis vectors to its own columns.
To find where a vector lands, scale each column by the matching coordinate and add the results.

sources.title: 4.2 Matrices and Transformations on Vectors; the Meaning of 0 Determinant
sources.quote: a matrix represents the transformation that takes the column basis vectors into the vectors that are the corresponding columns of the matrix.

sources.title: Linear transformations and matrices | 3Blue1Brown
sources.quote: you take the coordinates of that vector, multiply them by the corresponding column of the matrix, then add together what you get.
